title: Hermitian Hulls of Cyclic Codes and Exact Dual Distances of Extended Linear Codes
summary: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be an $[n,k,d]$ linear code over $\F_{q^2}$ with parity-check matrix $H$. The rank $r=\Rank(HH^{\dagger})$ measures how far the Hermitian dual $\mathcal{C}^{\perp_h}$ is from being Hermitian self-orthogonal, and it is the least number of coordinates that must be adjoined to $\mathcal{C}^{\perp_h}$ to make it Hermitian self-orthogonal; equivalently, the Hermitian hull $\mathcal{C}\cap\mathcal{C}^{\perp_h}$ has dimension $(n-k)-r$. In this paper, we develop a structure theory of the Hermitian hull of a cyclic code and apply it to the construction of quantum stabilizer codes.…
